A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same GeRaF 2.0 research work, with readable text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–C. Pages 2–15 have identical extracted text and rendered images; page 1 differs only in its project link and arXiv stamp.

before.justification: v1 reports original radar reconstruction experiments, quantitative comparisons in Table 1, novel-view synthesis results and additional experiments in Appendix A.

after.justification: v2 retains the same original reconstruction experiments, quantitative results, novel-view synthesis evaluations and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: Sections 4–5 retain the identical ULoS representation, lensless rendering procedure, two-stage training and RSDF alignment losses. No method component or model architecture changes.

E1.justification: Section 6 and Appendix A retain the same object scenes, bubble-wrap and nested-box scenarios, novel-view synthesis task and non-specular PLA bunny evaluation.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains Matched Filter and GeRaF as comparators. The corresponding qualitative comparisons also retain NeuS, with no comparator additions or removals.

E3.justification: The scanning configurations, held-out novel-view planes, training budgets, point-cloud processing and F1/Chamfer metrics are identical. Appendix A also retains the same scanning-density evaluation settings.

E4.justification: The ULoS rendering and RSDF alignment ablations, alignment-weight and training-progress analyses, scanning-density study, and robustness examples are unchanged in Section 6 and Appendix A.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals or significance tests. Both retain the same point-estimate and qualitative reporting.

E6.justification: All Table 1 entries, Figure 11 PSNR values and qualitative results in Figures 6–14 are identical. For example, the Bunny result for Ours remains F1 0.962 and reported CD 0.15 mm.

T1.justification: The definitions, equations and derivations in Sections 3–5 and Appendix B are identical, including the assumptions, proposition and proof in Section 5.1.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same claims about unified LoS/NLoS reconstruction, stable optimization, resolving surface ambiguity and state-of-the-art RF reconstruction.

C2.justification: The interpretations of reconstruction and alignment results are unchanged. Appendix C retains the same limitations concerning materials, unobserved surfaces and computational complexity.

D1.justification: The page-1 project address changes from https://ftpsens.epfl.ch/geraf/ to https://sens.epfl.ch/research/geraf/. Implementation details are unchanged; the PDFs do not establish any change in the linked resources' contents or availability.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and all 59 references are unchanged, including the positioning relative to GeRaF, mmNorm and radar-camera reconstruction methods.

P1.justification: Only administrative first-page text changes: the project address and the arXiv version/date stamp, from v1 dated 27 May 2026 to v2 dated 4 Aug 2026. Prose and document organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: Small visual changes are confined to the first-page margin stamp's placement and extent and the project-link footnote's width. Figures 1–14, Table 1, captions and all remaining page layouts are identical.

improvement.justification: The method, evidence, proofs, explanations and appendices are identical. The project-address update and administrative stamp changes establish no meaningful quality gain or loss; the PDFs do not demonstrate improved resource access.
